name: ServiceNow Platform
certifications: ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist - IT Service Management (CIS-ITSM)

beginner.summary: For new administrators, process owners and support staff. Covers the Now Platform and the Next Experience interface, users, groups and roles, tables and the dictionary, forms and lists, incident, problem and change, the service catalog, knowledge, Flow Designer, notifications, reports, data imports, the CMDB, access controls, SLAs, UI and data policies, update sets, the Employee Center and CSA exam preparation.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of IT support or business service processes
outcomes: Administer a ServiceNow instance: users, roles, tables, forms and lists
Configure ITSM processes, the catalog, knowledge and SLAs
Automate work with Flow Designer and notifications and build reports
Move configuration safely with update sets and prepare for the CSA exam

days.topic: ServiceNow Platform Overview and Instance Setup
subtopics: What ServiceNow is and where it is used
The Now Platform: one data model, many applications
Products: ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps and IRM
Instances, releases and the twice-yearly upgrade cycle
The Next Experience interface: menus, favourites and history
The application navigator and filter navigator
Lists, forms and the global search
days.lab_task: Request a Personal Developer Instance, brand it with a logo and colours, add favourites for common modules, find records with global search and impersonate a user to see their view.
days.deliverable: Branded instance screenshots and a navigation cheat sheet
checks: Menus differ from the admin view
Each family matched to a business need

subtopics: The admin, itil and catalog_admin roles
User administration with LDAP and SSO in brief
days.lab_task: Create three support groups with managers, assign roles through groups instead of to users, give one group an extra role through inheritance and check access by impersonating members.
days.deliverable: Groups, roles and access test notes
checks: Remove the user from the group
No roles assigned directly to users

days.topic: Tables, Fields and the Data Dictionary
subtopics: Extended tables and the Task table
days.lab_task: Create a custom equipment loan table that extends Task, add reference, choice and date fields, override a dictionary attribute for incident and view the schema map.
days.deliverable: Table definition and schema map screenshot
checks: Inherits Task fields such as number and assignment group
Values come from the referenced table
Applies only to the incident table

days.lab_task: Redesign the incident form for service desk agents with sections and a view, configure the list layout, add a related list and save filters for "my open incidents".
days.deliverable: Form and list configuration screenshots
checks: Only the user's open incidents shown
Personalise a list as a user

days.lab_task: Log, assign, work and resolve five incidents including a major incident, set up an assignment rule by category and show how priority follows impact and urgency.
days.deliverable: Incident records and assignment rule
checks: Assigned to the network group by the rule
Caller notified and the comment visible to them

subtopics: Change types: standard, normal and emergency
days.lab_task: Create a problem from repeated incidents, publish a known error, raise a normal change with risk assessment and approvals, and a standard change from a template.
days.deliverable: Problem, known error and change records

subtopics: Requests, requested items and catalog tasks
days.lab_task: Build a "new laptop" catalog item with variables and a variable set, a manager approval and fulfilment tasks, and a record producer that creates an incident from a simple form.
days.deliverable: Catalog item, record producer and a test request

subtopics: Knowledge in the portal and in incidents
days.lab_task: Create a knowledge base for IT with user criteria, write three articles from templates, publish them through approval and attach an article to an incident to resolve it.
days.deliverable: Knowledge base, articles and resolved incident
checks: Approval completed before it is visible
Attach an article to an incident

subtopics: When to use flows instead of scripts
days.lab_task: Build a flow that sends high-priority incidents to the on-call group, waits for acknowledgement and escalates after 15 minutes, and test it with the flow tester.
days.deliverable: Flow and execution details

subtopics: When to send: events and conditions
days.lab_task: Create notifications for incident assignment and resolution with a template, an inbound email action that adds replies as comments and check delivery in the email log.
days.deliverable: Notifications, inbound action and email log screenshots
checks: Reply added as a comment on the incident
Turn off a notification in preferences

days.lab_task: Build reports for open incidents by priority, mean time to resolve by group and changes by risk, combine them in a dashboard for the service desk manager and schedule a weekly email.
days.deliverable: Reports, dashboard and schedule
checks: Open as a user without access

days.topic: Importing Data with Import Sets and Transform Maps
subtopics: Data sources: files, JDBC and REST
days.lab_task: Import 500 users and their departments from a spreadsheet with coalescing on employee number, re-import updated data without duplicates and fix rows that failed.
days.deliverable: Data source, transform map and import logs
checks: Change a department in the file and re-import

subtopics: CI classes and the CI class manager
Linking CIs to incidents and changes
days.lab_task: Create servers, an application and a business service with relationships, link them to incidents and changes and view the dependency map and CMDB health.
days.deliverable: CIs, dependency map and health dashboard screenshot
checks: Raise an incident on a server

days.topic: Access Control Rules and Platform Security
subtopics: Operations: read, write, create and delete
Roles, conditions and scripts in ACLs
days.lab_task: Create ACLs so only HR can read a salary field and only managers can delete equipment loans, then test with impersonation and the security debugger.
days.deliverable: ACLs and debugging output
checks: Read the salary field as a non-HR user
Rule that allowed or denied access shown

days.lab_task: Define response and resolution SLAs for P1 and P2 incidents with business hours, pause them while waiting for the caller and alert at 75 percent of the time.
days.deliverable: SLA definitions and test results
checks: Put an incident on hold awaiting caller
Create a P1 outside business hours

subtopics: UI policies: mandatory, visible and read-only
Converting UI policies to data policies
UI policies compared with client scripts
days.lab_task: Make resolution notes mandatory when resolving, hide hardware fields for software categories and enforce a data policy that also applies to imports and the API.
days.deliverable: Policies and test results
checks: Resolve without notes on the form
Update through the REST API without notes

subtopics: Retrieving and previewing on the target
What update sets do not capture

days.deliverable: Update set, preview report and a note on uncaptured items
checks: Catalog item works on the second instance
Data records such as groups identified

subtopics: Catalog and knowledge in the portal
days.lab_task: Configure the Employee Center with the laptop item and IT knowledge, add an announcement, test search and order an item from the mobile app.
days.deliverable: Portal configuration and test screenshots
checks: Catalog item and article both found

days.lab_task: Take a timed CSA practice exam, review each wrong answer in the documentation, repeat the related lab task and take a second practice exam.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list
checks: Each linked to a documentation page

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: IT Service Desk on ServiceNow
days.lab_task: Configure a service desk for a 1,000-person company: groups and roles, incident and change, two catalog items, knowledge, SLAs, notifications, a dashboard and access rules, then move it with update sets and demo it.
days.deliverable: Configured instance, update sets, dashboard and demo recording
checks: Run an incident end to end
Assigned, worked and resolved within its SLA
Commit the update sets on the second instance
Each sees only what they should
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one service desk

intermediate.summary: For administrators moving into development and new ServiceNow developers. Covers GlideRecord and server-side scripting, business rules, client scripts and GlideAjax, script includes, UI actions, scoped applications in App Engine Studio, custom Flow Designer actions and IntegrationHub, scripted REST APIs, outbound integrations, the MID Server, events and scheduled jobs, the Automated Test Framework, portal widgets, UI Builder, Performance Analytics, Discovery, CMDB identification, debugging and the CAD exam.
prerequisites: Administers a ServiceNow instance at CSA level
outcomes: Write server and client scripts that follow platform good practice
Build scoped applications, custom actions and integrations
Test with ATF and build portal and workspace experiences
Use Discovery, CMDB identification and Performance Analytics

subtopics: Background scripts and when to avoid them
days.lab_task: Write background scripts that list open P1 incidents per group, count incidents by category with GlideAggregate and bulk-update a field safely in a test instance with a dry-run mode.
days.deliverable: Scripts and output
checks: Run the bulk update in dry-run mode
No unbounded queries or queries in loops

subtopics: Before, after, async and display rules
When rules run: insert, update, delete and query
days.lab_task: Write a before rule that sets priority for VIP callers, an after rule that creates a follow-up task, an async rule that calls a slow service and a display rule that passes data to the form.
days.deliverable: Business rules and test records
checks: Display rule data shown through g_scratchpad

subtopics: onLoad, onChange, onSubmit and onCellEdit scripts
Client scripts compared with UI policies
days.lab_task: Write an onChange script that fills caller details through an asynchronous GlideAjax call, an onSubmit validation and a catalog client script that shows a warning for expensive items.
days.deliverable: Client scripts, script include and test screenshots

days.lab_task: Move duplicated date and approval logic from several business rules into a script include class, call it from rules and flows, and extend a base script include for a custom rule.
days.deliverable: Script include and refactored rules
checks: Only in the script include now
Base method overridden without copying it

subtopics: Form buttons, links and context menus
days.lab_task: Add a "Create problem" button to incidents that copies details and links records, a list action to bulk-assign incidents and a confirmation before closing.
days.deliverable: UI actions and test screenshots
checks: Open as a user without the role

days.topic: Scoped Applications with App Engine Studio
subtopics: Creating apps in App Engine Studio
days.lab_task: Build a scoped equipment-booking app with tables, roles, a form, a flow and a script include, set cross-scope access rules and publish it to the application repository.
days.deliverable: Scoped application and repository version
checks: Call a protected script from another scope
Install the app on a second instance

days.topic: Custom Flow Designer Actions and IntegrationHub Spokes
days.lab_task: Build a custom action that creates a Jira issue through a REST step with a credential alias, handle errors, and use the Microsoft Teams spoke to post major incidents to a channel.
days.deliverable: Custom action, flow and execution details
checks: Error handled and logged in the flow
Stored in a credential alias, not in the action

days.topic: Scripted REST APIs and Inbound Integrations
subtopics: Authentication: basic, OAuth and mutual TLS
days.lab_task: Build a versioned scripted REST API for creating equipment bookings with OAuth, input validation and clear errors, and call it from Postman.
days.deliverable: API definition, Postman collection and responses

days.lab_task: Call an external asset service when a CI is created, parse the JSON response to fill fields, run the call asynchronously and retry when it fails.
days.deliverable: REST message, scripts and outbound log
checks: Fields filled from the external service
Call retried and the error logged
Form save not delayed by the call

subtopics: Installing and validating the MID Server
Running commands through the MID Server
days.lab_task: Install and validate a MID Server, call an internal REST service through it, configure a cluster for failover and check its status dashboard.
days.deliverable: MID Server configuration and test results
checks: Response returned through the MID Server
Work moves to the other cluster member

days.topic: Events, Scheduled Jobs and Background Processing
days.lab_task: Fire an event when equipment is overdue, send a notification and run a script action from it, and schedule a nightly job that processes overdue bookings in batches.
days.deliverable: Event, script action, scheduled job and logs

subtopics: Why automated tests on the platform
Form, server and REST test steps
days.lab_task: Write ATF tests for the incident priority rule, the laptop catalog item and the scripted REST API, combine them in a suite and schedule it to run nightly.
days.deliverable: Tests, suite and results
checks: Test fails with a clear step

subtopics: Widget structure: HTML, CSS, client and server scripts
days.lab_task: Build a "my equipment" widget that lists a user's bookings with options for page size, allows returning an item from the widget and passes an accessibility check.
days.deliverable: Widget code and portal page

days.lab_task: Build a workspace page for the equipment team with a list, a record view, a data resource for overdue items and a declarative action to extend a booking.
days.deliverable: Workspace page and action
checks: Built from components without custom HTML

days.lab_task: Create indicators for incident backlog and mean time to resolve with group breakdowns, collect historical data, set targets and thresholds and build a trend dashboard.
days.deliverable: Indicators, collection job and dashboard

subtopics: Discovering Windows, Linux and network devices
days.lab_task: Discover Windows and Linux servers through the MID Server, fix a credential error, view discovered CIs and relationships and schedule recurring discovery.
days.deliverable: Schedules, discovery logs and CI results
checks: Servers created as CIs with software and relationships

days.topic: CMDB Identification, Reconciliation and Data Quality
subtopics: Reconciliation rules and data source precedence
The Common Service Data Model in brief
days.lab_task: Load the same servers from Discovery and an import, configure identification and reconciliation rules so Discovery wins for hardware fields, fix duplicates and raise the health score.
days.deliverable: Rules, duplicate fixes and health scores before and after
checks: Load the same server from two sources
Update a hardware field from the import

subtopics: Logging with gs.info and session debug
days.lab_task: Debug a business rule with breakpoints, trace what changes a field with the script tracer, find a slow query in the logs and fix the script causing it.
days.deliverable: Debug notes and before and after timings

days.lab_task: Take a timed CAD practice exam, review wrong answers in the documentation, rebuild one weak-area feature in the lab and take a second practice exam.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Scoped Asset Booking Application
days.lab_task: Build a scoped asset booking application with tables, roles, ACLs, script includes, a workspace, a portal widget, a scripted REST API, an outbound integration through the MID Server, ATF tests and Performance Analytics, then publish and demo it.
days.deliverable: Application, ATF results, API collection and demo recording
checks: Book an asset through the API
Booking created and the external system updated
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one application
Build and integrate a scoped app

advanced.summary: For senior developers, platform owners and architects. Covers instance strategy and architecture, governance, upgrades and clones, CI/CD, the Common Service Data Model, Service Mapping and event management, Predictive Intelligence, Now Assist, Virtual Agent, integration architecture, performance at scale, security hardening, data lifecycle, workflow products (HRSD, CSM, SPM and IRM), technical debt, implementation leadership and production troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Develops scoped applications and integrations at CAD level
Has delivered ServiceNow work into production
outcomes: Design ServiceNow instance landscapes and govern the platform
Run upgrades, CI/CD and integrations at scale
Apply AI features, CSDM and ITOM to real services
Lead implementations and keep the platform healthy

days.topic: ServiceNow Platform Architecture and Instance Strategy
subtopics: Sub-production instance use and clone targets
Data residency and regional data centres
High availability and the ServiceNow cloud
days.lab_task: Design the instance landscape for a global company with strict data residency and three business units, decide on domain separation and record each decision with options.
days.deliverable: Landscape diagram and decision records
checks: Each region's data stays in an allowed data centre

days.topic: Platform Governance and the Centre of Excellence
days.lab_task: Set up governance for a growing platform: an intake process, design authority criteria, coding standards, a review checklist and a value dashboard, and run three demands through it.
days.deliverable: Governance pack and three reviewed demands
checks: Review a demand needing custom code

subtopics: Skipped records and the upgrade monitor
days.lab_task: Upgrade a lab instance to the next family release, review and resolve skipped records, run the ATF suite as a gate and clone production to test with exclusions and preserved data.
days.deliverable: Upgrade plan, skipped record decisions, ATF results and clone profile
checks: Each one merged, kept or reverted with a reason

days.topic: Source Control, CI/CD and DevOps for ServiceNow
subtopics: Application repository and the app store
Pipelines with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps
days.lab_task: Link the scoped app to Git, build a pipeline that runs Instance Scan and ATF, publishes the app and installs it on test, and create a change record automatically for production.
days.deliverable: Repository, pipeline and change record

days.topic: Common Service Data Model in Practice
subtopics: Business, application, technical and service domains
CSDM stages: foundation to fully crawl, walk, run and fly
days.lab_task: Model three business services with offerings, application services and technical services following CSDM, link them to support groups and use them in incidents, changes and reports.
days.deliverable: CSDM model, records and process examples
checks: Raise an incident on a service offering
Assignment and SLA follow the offering

subtopics: AIOps and Health Log Analytics in brief
days.lab_task: Map an application service from its URL entry point, ingest monitoring events from a connector, correlate alerts to the service and show service health changing during an outage.
days.deliverable: Service map, alert rules and outage screenshots

days.lab_task: Train a classification solution to predict incident assignment group, check precision and coverage, use it in a flow and find clusters of similar incidents for problem management.
days.deliverable: Solution definitions, accuracy reports and flow
checks: Predicted group assigned by the flow

days.topic: Now Assist and Generative AI on ServiceNow
subtopics: Now Assist for ITSM, HR and CSM
Generative AI in search and Virtual Agent
AI agents and agentic workflows on the platform
days.lab_task: Enable incident summarisation and resolution notes for a pilot group, build a custom skill with the Skill Kit, configure guardrails for personal data and measure time saved over 20 incidents.
days.deliverable: Configuration, custom skill, guardrail tests and measurement
checks: Include personal data in a prompt
objectives: Use generative AI on the platform

days.lab_task: Build Virtual Agent topics for password reset and laptop requests, publish them in Teams, hand over to a live agent when needed and measure deflection from test conversations.
days.deliverable: Topics, NLU model, Teams channel and deflection report
checks: Ask for a password reset in Teams
Handed to a live agent with context

subtopics: IntegrationHub, REST, SOAP and import sets compared
Event-driven integration with Stream Connect for Kafka
days.lab_task: Design integrations with an ERP, a monitoring tool and an HR system, choosing a pattern for each, implement the Kafka stream for monitoring events and add replay for failures.
days.deliverable: Integration design, Kafka stream and replay test
checks: Pattern chosen for each system with reasons

days.topic: Performance and Scalability of Large Instances
subtopics: Working with ServiceNow support on performance
days.lab_task: Find the five slowest transactions on a busy instance, fix scripts and request indexes, tune a slow list and report, and show before and after times.
days.deliverable: Performance report with fixes and timings

subtopics: Encryption: Edge Encryption, column encryption and KMF
days.lab_task: Raise the instance security score in Instance Security Center, enforce SSO with MFA, restrict admin access, encrypt a sensitive field and review a scoped app for script and API risks.
days.deliverable: Security score before and after, configuration and review report
checks: Score improved with each fix recorded
Log in as admin without MFA
Read the encrypted field without the role

days.topic: Data Lifecycle: Archiving, Retention and Table Cleanup
subtopics: Privacy requests and data subject rights
days.lab_task: Write archive rules for old incidents, set retention for audit and log tables, remove orphaned attachments safely and handle a data subject deletion request.
days.deliverable: Rules, retention settings and size reports
checks: Old incidents archived and still searchable

days.topic: HR Service Delivery and Customer Service Management
subtopics: HR cases, HR services and lifecycle events
days.lab_task: Configure an onboarding lifecycle event in HRSD with tasks across HR, IT and facilities, and a CSM case flow with a customer portal, then compare how both reuse platform features.
days.deliverable: Lifecycle event, case flow and comparison note
checks: Tasks created for HR, IT and facilities
Open an HR case as IT staff
Raise a customer case in the portal
Case routed to the right team

days.lab_task: Run three demands through assessment into projects, plan resources, track an agile team's sprint and build a portfolio roadmap for leadership.
days.deliverable: Demand records, project plans, sprint board and roadmap

days.lab_task: Load an ISO 27001 control set, link controls to CIs and owners, run an assessment, create automated indicators from CMDB data and track an issue to closure.
days.deliverable: Control set, assessments, indicators and issue

subtopics: Signs of technical debt on ServiceNow
days.lab_task: Run Instance Scan and a customisation review on a heavily customised instance, rank the debt by upgrade risk, revert three modified out-of-box records and replace a script with configuration.
days.deliverable: Debt register, fixes and scan results before and after
checks: Back to baseline with behaviour retested

days.lab_task: Run a fit-to-standard workshop for change management with role-play process owners, write ten stories, plan data migration and testing and write the cutover and hypercare plan.
days.deliverable: Workshop notes, stories, test plan and cutover plan

subtopics: An incident method for the platform
Reading system logs and node logs
days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected problems (a looping business rule, a stuck flow, an expired integration credential, an ACL blocking agents and a slow report after an upgrade), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review
checks: Recursion stopped and the cause removed
Agents regain access with the right scope

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Service Management Platform
days.lab_task: Design and deliver an enterprise service platform for a case company: instance strategy, governance, CSDM services fed by Discovery and Service Mapping, event correlation, predictive assignment and Now Assist, a CI/CD pipeline with ATF, hardening and an upgrade rehearsal, then present it to an architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, configured instance, pipeline, test results and board presentation
checks: Event correlated to the service and an incident assigned automatically
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
